thought.text: All containers started and core is healthy. Verifying the service:

reasoning_content:
The stack is up and running. After waiting a bit for everything to stabilize, I'll check the status and health, then verify with the following:
1. `docker compose ps` — all services healthy
2. API ping: `curl http://localhost/api/v2.0/ping`
3. Log in via the API: `curl -u admin:Harbor12345 http://localhost/api/v2.0/users/current`
4. Following the guide's push/pull procedure: log in with docker, tag alpine, push, pull.

action.command: sleep 20; cd /workspace/deploy/compose/example/local && docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml --env-file .env ps; echo "ping: $(curl -s -m 10 http://localhost/api/v2.0/ping)"; echo "auth: $(curl -s -m 10 -u admin:Harbor12345 http://localhost/api/v2.0/users/current)"
